fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Aramco (SA14TG012N13) is scheduled to announce Q3 2026 results on November 3, with the average target price from 18 analysts at SAR 30.25 (as of October 19).
fields.summary_ko.1: H1 2026 adjusted net income of SAR 251.9 billion and free cash flow excluding liquidity of SAR 226.0 billion were achieved, with market capitalization of SAR 6.2 trillion at the October 21 closing price of SAR 25.54.
